critique: The pastoral sunset, drifting creatures, and net-wielding player give the catching game a friendly identity, yet the creatures are variations of the same rounded blob and the field reads as a decorative postcard more than a living ecology. The collection concept lacks a memorable capture-state visual.
suggestion: Differentiate creatures by habitat-driven silhouette, motion, and rarity cues; add layered environmental activity and a clear expressive net/capture moment; and make the collection count use small specimen marks that reinforce discovery rather than generic dashboard chrome.
audit_note: Direct Codex critic output grounded in the shared r0 screenshot; not an API raw-response object.
